WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    races.name,
    SUM(results.points) as points_total
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
),
overall_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(points_total) as overall_sum 
  FROM race_totals
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    rt.name,
    rt.points_total,
    CASE 
      WHEN ot.overall_sum IS NOT NULL AND rt.points_total IS NOT NULL
      THEN CAST(rt.points_total AS FLOAT) / ot.overall_sum
      ELSE NULL
    END as share
  FROM race_totals rt
  CROSS JOIN overall_total ot
),
shares_only AS (
  SELECT share FROM with_share WHERE share IS NOT NULL
),
avg_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares_only
)
SELECT 
  ws.name,
  ws.points_total,
  ws.share,
  ws.share - asv.avg_share as share_diff
FROM with_share ws
CROSS JOIN avg_share_value asv
WHERE asv.avg_share IS NOT NULL
AND ws.share IS NOT NULL
AND ws.share > asv.avg_share
ORDER BY ws.name
